"day_vol 1.17 is above normal". Above normal is not my test: C16 needs day_vol 1.40, under it is a rejection. W 9.7% above last swing high with lens coil warn: no base behind the pivot. Stand.
"HH/HL within 0.1 of their highs". That is trend at the high, not a base. W 9.7% above last swing high, lens coil warn, day_vol 1.17 under 1.40: unconfirmed. A 1.40 break would move me. Stand.

"structure 66.3 is modest, not failing". Agreed, modest. Modest structure with lens coil warn is no completed base (R3). day_vol 0.98 under 1.40, D 3.3% under 20-day high: a break without volume is unconfirmed. Stand.
"day_vol 0.98 is ordinary". Ordinary is my failure: C16 needs day_vol 1.40 on the break. W/D/H1 HH/HL is trend intact, but lens coil warn means no base to break from. Stand.
